title: Track Them Down!
notes: Old Man Jenkins tells the Soldier to head out, setting them off on their adventure

n1.speaker: Old Man Jenkins
n1.text: Drat! One of them ran off! Quick, you better get after them. Rats always scurry back to their nest. Do you need anything before you set out?

n5.speaker: Old Man Jenkins
n5.text: Good thinking, take this water pouch.

n7.text: Old Man Jenkins gives you a kiss on the forehead

n8.speaker: Old Man Jenkins
n8.text: Now get out there! And get back before I croak, it get's lonely in this tower
